title: EMSA EMCIP as European marine casualty information platform rail
summary: EMCIP is encoded as a European marine casualty information platform: a rail for storing casualty/incident information and enabling analysis across technical, human, environmental and organizational factors, while not replacing full reports or recommendation-closure audits.

status_history.note: Added as rev0028 marine casualty investigation / correction rail.

place.scope: marine casualty investigation and safety-learning infrastructure

subjects.name: EMSA EMCIP as European marine casualty information platform rail

claims.claim: EMSA says EMCIP stores information on marine casualties/incidents involving all types of ships and occupational accidents, and supports statistics and analysis of technical, human, environmental and organisational factors.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: For this cube, EMCIP is a denominator/analysis rail rather than a complete public report archive or proof of correction infusion.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: European platform for storing casualty/incident records and supporting statistical/factor analysis
limitations: public accessibility and detail may vary
database presence does not prove full investigation quality or learning
not a substitute for full investigation reports

handling_notes: Infrastructure records are correction-memory surfaces, not guarantees that recommendations or operating practice actually changed.
Marine-casualty records must preserve the dignity of passengers, crew, families, responders, and survivors.
Do not collapse safety-investigation causal language into individual blame; separate safety investigation, legal liability, vessel operation, design, maintenance, and emergency-response surfaces.
This is historical/evidentiary infrastructure, not operational navigation, stability, damage-control, legal, regulatory, or emergency guidance.

next_actions: Audit how EMCIP relates to national investigation reports and IMO GISIS casualty data.
